name: Aggregation
description: Aggregates values within a partition using specified function

formula.notes: With axis='rows' the aggregate is taken over the records of each partition. With axis='roles' it is taken over the values bound to the value role on one record; partition is then ignored.

configurations.name: axis
configurations.description: Direction of aggregation. 'rows' collapses multiple records within each partition to one value (the existing behaviour). 'roles' combines the several values bound to the value role on a single record — e.g. the earliest of a progression date and a death date — leaving record cardinality unchanged.

output_classes.description: The aggregated value per partition group

input_roles.name: value
input_roles.description: The values to aggregate. Single for axis='rows'; two or more for axis='roles'.
